desc:
🥚 Chase AN EGG! 🏃

🦵 These Eggs have LEGS, and they RUN! Chase them down and bring them home!

💡 How to Play:

⚡ Every Egg shows its Speed. Be FASTER to catch it!
🥚 Run your Egg back to the Village to keep it!
😱 Guardians chase you home. Too slow and they'll knock your Egg loose
🍳 SLAP other players to knock their Eggs loose!
🐣 Hatch Eggs into Pets that earn you Cash!
🏋️ Use your Treadmill to get FASTER!
🌍 Go farther for faster, rarer Eggs!
🥚 Can you catch the Jungle Mythic?

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!

🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, and Tablet!

Simulator, Eggs, Pets, Speed, Chase, Catch, Treadmill, Tycoon, Hatch, Steal, Slap,
Catch a Pet, Chase an Egg, Chase a Pet, Steal an Egg, Fun
